note: Written before the LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK and CrewAI adapters existed. Every framework runs the same scripted plan through its own runtime, with no model calls. receipt = what the adapter writes; native = the framework's own record of the same run (the cheap baseline), reduced by the example to a list of {tool, args, output, is_error}.

native_marks_the_failure_as_an_error_gue.note: A guess written down before running: LangGraph's ToolMessage has status=error; the other two hand the model an error string. Scored, not enforced.
